title: Proper pro-etale exchange on a bounded-below finite etale origin
statement: For a finite commutative coefficient ring A, a Cartesian square of arbitrary schemes with p proper, and a fixed-A pro-etale complex K of bounded-below etale origin, the published ordinary derivedBaseChangeMap at K is invertible. No standing-field hypothesis or qcqs condition on the base-change schemes is required.

source.place: Coefficient transport and clauses (2)--(3), canonical-map identifications.

proof.text: Retain an etale antecedent C and its comparison isomorphism. Finite A is additively torsion, so etale proper base change makes the etale exchange invertible. Properness makes p and its base change qcqs. The canonical site-comparison source and target isomorphisms identify the ordinary exchange on the comparison image with the image of the etale exchange. Transport along the retained object isomorphism using naturality.
